title: Cancer treatment innovations in China
text:
Interesting article about Australians (and a few Americans) going to China for the latest cancer therapies? The more interesting aspect is the technique of CAR-T therapy, for certain cancers, now extending to solid tumors is exciting!
Of course, the Chinese system of "industrializing" supply chains is famous, but extending to medical therapies is interesting.  We can obviously debate the politics of innovation, costs of care, US health care, etc. But an interesting dynamic is developing.
